title: Fathala Safari & Guided Lion Walk
polishTitle: Fathala: safari i spacer z lwami
summary: Cross into Senegal for a 4×4 safari in Fathala Wildlife Reserve, with a guided lion-walk option arranged in advance. A full day of wildlife and changing landscapes.
polishSummary: Safari 4×4 w Fathala w Senegalu z opcją spaceru z lwami uzgadnianą przed rezerwacją.

stops.title: From The Gambia to Senegal
stops.description: Travel from your coastal hotel towards Senegal. We plan the crossing and reserve visit around the day’s ferry and border arrangements.

stops.title: A safari through Fathala
stops.description: Explore the reserve by 4×4 with time to look for wildlife and take photographs. Animal sightings vary; no particular species is guaranteed.

stops.title: The guided lion-walk option
stops.description: Tell us whether you want the lion walk included. Participation, availability and the reserve’s rules are confirmed before booking.

stops.title: Lunch and return
stops.description: Pause for a local lunch before the journey back to your hotel in The Gambia.

included: Local lunch and water / soft drinks
Guided lion walk when confirmed in your booked itinerary
excluded: Personal purchases, tips and optional activities not confirmed in the quote.
notes: Full day; border and ferry conditions affect the overall duration.
Price and minimum group size are confirmed personally before booking.
Reserve participation rules apply to the lion walk.

title: Bijilo Monkeys, Kachikally & Serrekunda
summary: One day, several sides of The Gambia: a guided walk in Bijilo Forest Park, the cultural heritage of Kachikally, Serrekunda Market and a local artist’s studio.
polishSummary: Małpy w Bijilo, święte krokodyle w Kachikally, zakupy w Serrekundzie i wizyta u lokalnego artysty.

stops.title: Bijilo Forest Park
stops.description: Walk through the coastal forest with your guide and look for monkeys among the trees. Leave time to enjoy the setting and observe the animals.

stops.title: Kachikally in Bakau
stops.description: Visit the crocodile pool and small museum, learning about the site’s cultural importance and local traditions.

stops.title: Serrekunda Market
stops.description: Browse textiles, spices, crafts and everyday market stalls. Your guide helps you navigate the market and understand local shopping customs.

stops.title: A local artist’s studio
stops.description: Finish with a studio visit and an introduction to paintings inspired by Gambian life before returning to your hotel.

included: Guide, with language arranged in advance
excluded: Lunch, shopping, souvenirs, alcohol and tips.
notes: Around 7 hours; hotel pickup location affects timings.
Published group departure: 4–10 guests. Smaller private groups can ask for a separate quote.

title: Makasutu Forest & Mangrove Boat Trip
summary: Spend a day among Makasutu’s forest paths and mangrove waterways, with a guided walk, boat trip, outdoor lunch and a traditional dance performance.
polishSummary: Las Makasutu, rejs wśród namorzynów, lokalne tradycje, lunch i pokaz tańca afrykańskiego.

stops.title: Through the mangroves
stops.description: Begin with a boat trip along the forest waterways, watching the riverbanks and looking for birdlife.

stops.title: A walk in the forest
stops.description: Explore Makasutu with a local guide and hear about Mandinka traditions and plants used in local culture.

stops.title: Lunch and living traditions
stops.description: Enjoy an outdoor lunch and a traditional dance performance. An optional marabout consultation can be discussed locally.

stops.title: Back to the coast
stops.description: Return to your hotel after a full day away from the resort bustle.

included: Mangrove boat trip and forest walk
excluded: Drinks with lunch, tips and the optional marabout consultation.
notes: Shared departures are advertised on Sundays, subject to confirmation.
Usually around 08:00–17:00, depending on pickup.
Private dates can be requested separately.

title: Gambia River Cruise & Fishing Day
polishTitle: Rejs po rzece Gambia i wędkowanie
summary: A relaxed day aboard a double-deck boat: try fishing, watch the riverbanks, enjoy lunch on board or simply settle into the slower rhythm of the River Gambia.
polishSummary: Całodniowy rejs komfortową łodzią z wędkowaniem, posiłkiem i napojami bezalkoholowymi.

stops.title: A morning on the river
stops.description: Board the double-deck boat and find a comfortable spot in the shade or on the upper deck.

stops.title: Fishing and river life
stops.description: Try fishing at suitable points chosen by the crew according to conditions and tides. Fishing is optional, and catches are not guaranteed.

stops.title: Lunch on board
stops.description: Pause for an included meal and soft drinks while enjoying the views.

stops.title: An unhurried afternoon
stops.description: Continue cruising, look for birds and take photographs before the return journey.

included: River cruise on a double-deck boat
Time for fishing, relaxation and photographs
excluded: Alcohol, personal expenses and tips; confirm hotel transfer arrangements in your quote.
notes: Around 8 hours. Maximum published boat group: 10 guests.
Departure minimum and hotel transfers are confirmed for your date.

title: South Gambia: River, Sanyang & Tanji
summary: Discover Kachikally, cruise near Lamin Lodge, pause at Sanyang Paradise Beach and see coastal life in Tanji. A varied day with transport, a boat trip and Gambian lunch.
polishSummary: Kachikally, rejs z okolic Lamin Lodge, plaża Sanyang i życie rybaków w Tanji z lunchem w cenie.

stops.title: Kachikally and Bakau
stops.description: Visit the crocodile pool and discover the traditions surrounding this important local site.

stops.title: Lamin Lodge and the mangroves
stops.description: Take a boat trip through river and mangrove landscapes, with the Daranka area and its distinctive elephant-shaped tree on the route.

stops.title: Sanyang Paradise Beach
stops.description: Enjoy time by the Atlantic and an included Gambian-style lunch. Beach activities depend on local conditions.

stops.title: Tanji fishing village
stops.description: See the working fishing coast and colorful boats before returning to your hotel. Boat arrivals and the light vary with the day.

included: Return hotel transport and local guide
excluded: Extra food or drinks not listed, personal purchases and tips.
notes: Full day; the order of stops may change to suit conditions.
Group departure: 4–10 guests.

title: Mangrove Kayaking in The Gambia
summary: Explore quiet mangrove channels by kayak, with time for birdlife, river scenery and a closer look at life along the water. Ask us to plan an outing that fits your pace.
polishSummary: Aktywna wyprawa kajakiem przez namorzyny i spokojne rozlewiska rzeki Gambia.

stops.title: Plan the right outing
stops.description: Tell us your kayaking experience, preferred pace and pickup area. We confirm a suitable route and the day’s arrangements.

stops.title: Paddle through the channels
stops.description: Explore mangrove waterways and pause to enjoy the changing river scenery and birdlife.

stops.title: Return at an easy pace
stops.description: Finish the outing and follow the transfer arrangements agreed for your group.

included: Kayaking route and local arrangements confirmed in your personal quote
Transport, equipment and guiding specified before booking
excluded: Meals, drinks and any services not included in your agreed quote.
notes: Advertised as a full-day outing; exact duration, tide-dependent route and group size are confirmed individually.
Tell us about swimming ability, children and any mobility needs when enquiring.

title: Kunta Kinteh Island, Albreda & Juffureh
polishTitle: Wyspa Kunta Kinteh, Albreda i Juffureh
summary: A thoughtful journey into the region’s history: visit Kunta Kinteh Island and the river communities of Albreda and Juffureh, with classic ferry and premium private-boat options.
polishSummary: Rejs na Wyspę Kunta Kinteh oraz Albreda i Juffureh — wariant klasyczny i premium.

stops.title: Choose your river journey
stops.description: The classic route combines the Banjul–Barra ferry, onward road transport and a boat to the island. The premium option uses a private boat from Denton Bridge.

stops.title: Albreda and Juffureh
stops.description: The classic itinerary includes these historic river communities, with local stories and heritage stops.

stops.title: Kunta Kinteh Island
stops.description: Explore the island and learn about the history of the transatlantic slave trade and the importance of remembrance.

stops.title: Return from the river
stops.description: Follow the return route agreed for your chosen variant, allowing for ferry, river and weather conditions.

included: Transport, boat trip and entrance fees as listed in the chosen route
Ferry tickets on the classic route
excluded: Meals, personal purchases, tips and services not listed for your chosen variant.
notes: Full day; exact timings depend on your variant and conditions.
Classic: €110 per person, minimum 4. Premium private boat: €150 per person, minimum 2.
Confirm whether Albreda and Juffureh are included in your selected premium route.

variants.label: Classic ferry route — €110 per person, minimum 4
Premium private boat — €150 per person, minimum 2

title: Banjul City & Serrekunda Markets
summary: Discover historic Banjul, the river mouth and two lively markets in one day. This shared-departure route includes Albert Market and Serrekunda Market, with Thursday departures on request.
polishSummary: Banjul, Albert Market i Serrekunda Market — całodzienna wycieczka z planowanymi wyjazdami w czwartki.

stops.title: Historic Banjul
stops.description: Walk through the former Bathurst with a local guide, taking in McCarthy Square and the city’s architectural history.

stops.title: The port and river mouth
stops.description: Pause around the waterfront and discover how the River Gambia shaped the capital’s trading history.

stops.title: Albert Market
stops.description: Explore stalls selling fabrics, spices, crafts and everyday essentials.

stops.title: Serrekunda Market
stops.description: Continue to Serrekunda for another perspective on local life and shopping, then return to your hotel.

excluded: Shopping, food, drinks, personal expenses and tips unless agreed in your quote.
notes: Full-day group route; Thursday departures subject to confirmation.
Published group size: 4–10. Private dates can be requested at a separate price.
This is a longer two-market route than our private half-day Banjul tour.

title: 2-Day Janjanbureh, River & Wassu
polishTitle: 2 dni: Janjanbureh, rzeka Gambia i Wassu
summary: Travel inland for river scenery around Janjanbureh and Baboon Islands, an overnight stay and the historic Wassu Stone Circles. A deeper look at The Gambia beyond the coast.
polishSummary: Dwudniowa wyprawa do Janjanbureh, rejs w okolicach Baboon Islands, nocleg i kamienne kręgi Wassu.

stops.title: Into the Central River region
stops.description: Travel from the coast to Janjanbureh, watching the scenery and settlements change along the way.

stops.title: River time and an overnight stay
stops.description: Take a boat trip towards the Baboon Islands area, looking for birdlife and other wildlife, before an overnight stay in or near Janjanbureh.

stops.title: Wassu and the return journey
stops.description: Visit the Wassu Stone Circles on the second day and return towards the coast.

included: One overnight stay in or near Janjanbureh
Listed entrances, Wassu visit and a meal as confirmed in the itinerary
excluded: Extra meals and drinks not listed, personal expenses and tips.
notes: 2 days / 1 night; wildlife sightings are not guaranteed.
We confirm the accommodation, meal plan and individual price before booking.
A separate one-day express version is also available.

title: Janjanbureh & Central River Express
summary: An intensive one-day alternative for travelers who want to reach central Gambia without an overnight stay. Ask us to confirm the river activities and stops that fit the express schedule.
polishSummary: Intensywny jednodniowy wariant wyprawy do centralnej Gambii, bez noclegu.

stops.title: An early start from the coast
stops.description: Set off early for the Central River region. The published express schedule starts around 06:00.

stops.title: Central Gambia in a day
stops.description: We confirm which Janjanbureh, river and heritage stops can realistically be included for your date and starting point.

stops.title: Return to your hotel
stops.description: Expect a long day, with a late return that may be around 21:00–22:00 depending on the route and conditions.

included: Return road transport and local guiding
Express itinerary, river activities, entrances and meal arrangements confirmed before booking
excluded: Overnight accommodation, personal purchases, tips and anything not confirmed in the express quote.
notes: This is an intensive travel day, not the overnight itinerary compressed without changes.
€150 per person is the published express rate; the final route is confirmed for your group.

title: 2-Day Fathala Safari & Saloum Delta
summary: Combine a 4×4 safari in Senegal’s Fathala Wildlife Reserve with an overnight lodge stay and a boat trip among the mangroves of the Saloum Delta.
polishSummary: Safari 4×4 w Fathala, nocleg w lodge i rejs wśród namorzynów Delty Saloum.

stops.title: A safari day in Senegal
stops.description: Leave The Gambia, complete the border arrangements and head into Fathala for a 4×4 wildlife safari.

stops.title: An evening at your lodge
stops.description: After the safari, settle into the lodge selected for your booking. The accommodation standard and meal plan are agreed in your quote.

stops.title: Saloum Delta and Toubakouta
stops.description: On day two, head towards Toubakouta for a mangrove boat trip and birdwatching before returning to your hotel in The Gambia.

excluded: Other meals or drinks not confirmed in the quote, personal expenses and tips.
notes: 2 days / 1 night. Price depends on lodge standard and group size.
The practical group size and border arrangements are confirmed before booking.

title: 8-Day Gambia & Senegal Discovery
summary: An eight-day journey from The Gambia to Dakar and back, combining Bandia safari, Gorée Island, the Saloum Delta, Kunta Kinteh Island and time on the coast.
polishSummary: 8-dniowa wyprawa: Gambia, Dakar, safari Bandia, Gorée, Sine-Saloum i Wyspa Kunta Kinteh.

stops.label: Day 1
stops.title: Arrival in The Gambia
stops.description: Airport transfer to your coastal accommodation and time to settle in. The final hotel is confirmed with your booking.

stops.label: Day 2
stops.title: Banjul and Gambian culture
stops.description: Explore Banjul and its cultural stops, with Kachikally and a visit to Monkey Park on the proposed route.

stops.label: Day 3
stops.title: Into Senegal: Lac Rose and Bandia
stops.description: Travel to Senegal, visit the Lac Rose area and enjoy a Bandia reserve safari before continuing to Dakar. The lake’s appearance varies naturally.

stops.label: Day 4
stops.title: Dakar and Gorée Island
stops.description: Discover Dakar, including the African Renaissance Monument, and take a boat to Gorée for an important encounter with the region’s history.

stops.label: Day 5
stops.title: The Saloum Delta
stops.description: Head south for a boat trip through Saloum’s mangroves before returning to The Gambia.

stops.label: Day 6
stops.title: Kunta Kinteh Island
stops.description: Spend the day on the River Gambia and visit Kunta Kinteh Island, with time to reflect on the island’s history.

stops.label: Day 7
stops.title: Serrekunda and the coast
stops.description: Explore the market and local communities, then enjoy time at Paradise Beach.

stops.label: Day 8
stops.title: Departure
stops.description: Breakfast and an airport transfer arranged around your flight schedule.

Transfers, ferry and cross-border transport as listed
